scope: Selected project-authored research and checkpoint utilities only
checkpoint_verifier_strategy: Keep separate earlier/later entry points with shared stronger checks. This is consolidation of nonidentical implementations, not exact-source deduplication.

files.adaptation: Explicit output and token-variable selection; required network opt-in; fixed public host; public visibility checked even for cached snapshots; no login, account discovery or candidate execution.
Explicit corpus and documentation roots; source-neutral runtime acceptance; preserved hashes, revisions, license classification, line ranges, video/image evidence and generated-view/link checks.
All 16 original behavioral cases retained; owned synthetic directories and explicit mocked token selection; source-bearing API errors are no longer echoed.

Removed fixed repository, revision and filesystem locations. Explicit local object store, source URL, commit/tree and output; lazy network fetch disabled; bounded blobs; relative snapshot path; no inferred visibility or branch observation.
No import-time inventory reads. Explicit root, verified source bytes, declaration/frontmatter extraction and static Python/JSON/script/query catalogs retained. Empty CSV categories receive headers.
Private source labels, package facts and fixed counts removed; computed counts and explicitly supplied reference/skill/asset notes drive source links and coverage views.
Explicit source, inventory and output arguments plus passive help; source hashes checked before parsing text; no script execution; actual links rejected without rejecting ordinary synchronized files.
Explicit source/object/context/host boundaries; dynamic expected parse sets; no fixed private test results or host baseline; read-only unless receipt output is selected.

Removed embedded service/project/wiki/page identity, recorded approvals and operational events. Explicit service aliases, root and pre-provisioned token variable; no Azure CLI identity lookup; explicit network/resume/retry choices. Scoped enumeration, pinned blobs, reference parsing, accounting, escaped views and verification retained.

Embedded private taxonomy, page membership, attachment findings, approval claims and observed totals withheld. Explicit source-bound notes/taxonomy drive the working assembly and rendering logic; no semantic or human approval is manufactured.

Import-time writes and automatic processing approval removed. New separate output, verified bytes, bounded indexed page fragments and explicit optional readability compaction. All outputs remain REVIEW_REQUIRED; attachments remain NOT_REVIEWED.
Import-time processing removed. Explicit root; hash verification before reference refinement; prior reference index preserved; new attachments fail without fetching; authorization unchanged.
Explicit root; dynamic source/artifact/note/image counts; read-only default; optional PNG integrity checks and receipt output; no corpus promotion or approval mutation.
All 17 original parser/classification cases retained with synthetic project aliases and page IDs; no actual exported wiki files are opened.
Original three pinned package requirements retained as metadata. No third-party source or dependency cache is published.

All roots, selections, categories, receipt expectations, predecessor and identifier are explicit. No historical research metadata, automatic archive inclusion, checkpoint-local Python loading or power helpers. Bounded archive creation and read-back/working comparison retained.
All ten original checkpoint tests retained; package-owned verifier and newly created owned synthetic files/archives only.

Explicit checkpoint and optional working root; no location inference. Later duplicate/case/path/digest checks retained with bounded streaming and archive type checks; earlier size_changed reporting retained. No extraction.

Distinct earlier entry point delegates to the stronger package-owned verification implementation. Original files were not identical; archive-only and optional working comparison remain, without historical roots or unsafe permissive paths.

withheld_from_source_scripts: Embedded private service, organization, project, repository, wiki and page identifiers
Fixed source/host revisions, personal filesystem locations and automatic account-selection defaults
Historical approval assertions, operational events, source-derived findings and fixed observed counts
Automatic selection of prior private archives, unrelated workspaces, support receipts or power helpers
excluded_inputs_not_exported: Original research/source corpora and private manifests
Checkpoint archive contents and original private Git history
Captured third-party implementation code, vendor caches and installers
Credentials, runtime state and historical operational receipts

validation.environment: Run from publication root with PYTHONPATH set explicitly to research_tools\.validation-deps
validation.powershell_source_parsing: PASS on one newly authored synthetic script; the script was not executed
initial_failures_and_corrections: Five preserved wiki cases initially errored because markdown_it was unavailable; declared dependencies were restored into an ignored target-owned directory and the cases passed.
The first expanded suite exposed an overbroad PowerShell reparse-point guard; it was corrected to reject actual symbolic links and junctions, and the complete suite passed.
validation.limited_removed_default_scan: No selected private-default patterns matched; this is NOT source/data clearance.
validation.cleanup: Synthetic fixtures removed. Initial shutil.rmtree of the empty read-only installation scratch directory failed with WinError 5; guarded Remove-Item -Force then removed that directory without ACL changes. Declared validation dependencies remain only in an ignored target-owned directory.
validation.git_operations: Read-only status, HEAD, diff/check-ignore inspection only; no staging, commits, pushes, auth or network Git operations
validation.full_application_suite_and_project_state: NOT_RUN by this bounded worker; coordinator integration responsibility

limitations: This record covers the 19 selected authored inputs, not every file in the operator workspace.
Manual utility adaptation and finite pattern checks do not establish rights or privacy clearance of source data.
Network stages were exercised only with inert mocks; real service/authentication acceptance is NOT_ASSESSED.
Checkpoint tests use newly created synthetic archives only; no real checkpoint corpus was opened or frozen.
Repository publication, canonical project records and final integration belong to the coordinator.
